items.stance: Negotiated as the incoming governing party, and voted for,

items.text: In a governing coalition, enacted a law allowing carbon dioxide to be captured, carried by pipeline, and stored under the seabed, leaving storage on land to regional governments to allow.

In a governing coalition, enacted a law to tender 11 gigawatts of new gas power plants, to run by 2031 and switch to hydrogen by 2045, paid for by a new charge on electricity customers that the government estimated at up to about 0.07 percent of a year's economic output in 2031.
